title: 第1354章 注定的命运第1353章 压倒性优势
content_zh:
高山露出阴冷的笑容。
这群家伙从进入到华夏那一刻，从他们兵戎相向起就注定了不是你死就是我亡的命运。
提刀杀人放刀活命？
在他这里可没那好事。
他是有仁心，他是敬畏生命，可从他知道外来修炼者要侵入华夏、要屠尽华夏人那一刻起，他的另一个人格就在成长了。
这一重任何下，他是一个杀神，是一个恶魔！
高山刚要下令，南宫梦突然到近前，喊道:“高山哥，等一下！”
“你要为他们求情？你知道我对他们的态度的。”高山没有下令，转身看向南宫梦。
他现在已经完全认可了南宫梦，对她不再怀疑。
她可以不参与任何对外来修炼者的战斗，可以完全的置身事外，但也不该为他们求情，她应该了解自己的原则。
不过高山选择尊重南宫梦，所以并没立即下令。
南宫梦却摇头道:“我不会强你所难，但他们当中有我一位故友，是我从小的玩伴，希望你能饶他一命，哪怕废了他让他做个普通人也行。”
南宫梦露出真挚的眼神，恳求着。
这个要求的确不算过分。
高山迟疑了下点了点头，说道:“我答应你，就按你说的做吧！”
南宫梦听后露出喜色，表示了感谢立即去到被围困的人那边。
“南宫小姐，是南宫小姐，南宫小姐你是加入了他们吗，麻烦你为我们求下情。”
“我们也愿意和南宫小姐一样弃暗投明。”
“对，我们愿意和你们一同守护这里，一同战斗。”
……

众人看到南宫梦感觉活命的机会大起来了。
既然能接受南宫梦，那自然也会接受他们。
南宫梦没有理会他们，看向人群中一人，喊道:“秦哲，你出来吧！”
人群中，满脸是血，身上也受了不少伤的少年走了出来，含情脉脉，神情激动的看着南宫梦:“没想到这么快就遇见你了，我得知你偷偷跟虫族先来这里，一直牵挂着你，好在你无恙。”
秦哲伸手就要去拉南宫梦的手，不过南宫梦伸手避开了。
高山将这一切都看在眼中，看来两人之前关系并不简单，难怪南宫梦要为秦哲求情。
“谢谢你的牵挂，但你不该不听我的劝告的，哪怕你被逼迫下来也不该动手的。你自行废去修为吧，从今往后就留在这里做个普通人。”南宫梦艰难开口。
秦哲一直就是一个很要强，很有抱负的人，他一定很难接受。
“为什么？我不能成为废人，那和死了有什么区别？”秦哲神情激动的嘶吼着。
这时候，高山走来，神色盯着秦哲说道:“死或者废掉修为，你自己选择。若不是看在南宫梦的面子，你连选择的机会都没有。”
“你是谁？”秦哲看向高山问道。
他之前见过高山出手，知道他是孕婴大能，所以语气还算恭敬。
“高山！”
“天道所选的人。”
content_en:
Gao Shan showed a cold smile.
From the moment this group of guys entered China and from the moment they fought against each other, they were destined to die either you or me.
Carrying a knife to kill someone and putting it away to survive?
That's not a good thing with him.
He has a benevolent heart and respects life, but from the moment he knew that foreign cultivators were going to invade China and massacre the Chinese people, his other personality was growing.
At this moment, he is a murderer and a devil!
Just as Gao Shan was about to give the order, Nangong Meng suddenly came closer and shouted: "Brother Gao Shan, wait a minute!"
"You want to plead for them? You know my attitude towards them." Gao Shan did not give an order, but turned to look at Nangong Meng.
He has now fully recognized Nangong Meng and no longer doubts her.
She can not participate in any battles against outside cultivators, and she can stay completely out of it, but she should not plead for them either. She should understand her own principles.
However, Gao Shan chose to respect Nangong Meng, so he did not give the order immediately.
Nangong Meng shook his head and said: "I won't force you to do anything difficult, but among them is an old friend of mine who was my childhood playmate. I hope you can spare his life, even if you cripple him and let him become an ordinary person."
Nangong Meng showed sincere eyes and begged.
This request is indeed not too much.
Gao Shan hesitated for a moment and nodded, and said, "I promise you, I will do as you say!"
Nangong Meng was happy after hearing this, expressed her gratitude and immediately went to the besieged people.
"Miss Nangong, it's Miss Nangong. Did you join them, Miss Nangong? Please beg for mercy for us."
"We are also willing to abandon the darkness and turn to the light like Miss Nangong."
"Yes, we are willing to protect this place with you and fight together."
…
When everyone saw Nangong Meng, they felt that their chances of survival increased.
Since he can accept Nangong Meng, he will naturally accept them as well.
Nangong Meng ignored them, looked at one of the people in the crowd, and shouted: "Qin Zhe, come out!"
Among the crowd, a young man with blood on his face and many injuries on his body came out and looked at Nangong Meng affectionately and excitedly: "I didn't expect to meet you so soon. I learned that you came here secretly with the Zerg and have been thinking about you. Fortunately, you are okay."
Qin Zhe reached out to grab Nangong Meng's hand, but Nangong Meng dodged it.
Gao Shan saw all this in his eyes. It seemed that the relationship between the two was not simple before. No wonder Nangong Meng wanted to plead for Qin Zhe.
"Thank you for your concern, but you should not ignore my advice, even if you are forced to do so. You should abandon your cultivation and stay here and be an ordinary person from now on." Nangong Meng said with difficulty.
Qin Zhe has always been a very strong and ambitious person, so it must be difficult for him to accept this.
"Why? I can't become a useless person. What's the difference between that and death?" Qin Zhe roared excitedly.
At this time, Gao Shan came over, stared at Qin Zhe and said, "You choose to die or abandon your cultivation. If it weren't for Nangong Meng's sake, you wouldn't even have a chance to choose."
"Who are you?" Qin Zhe looked at Gao Shan and asked.
He had seen Gao Shan take action before and knew that he was an expert in pregnant women, so his tone was quite respectful.
"Mountain!"
"The person chosen by heaven."
